lines: The rough cut is made: 60 s, nine shots, four shakes of one bar each. It is cut from the approved images on a placeholder beat, with no sound. It exists so you can judge the order and the pace of the film.
Phase 0 closed with all seven machine checks green. Next: Phase 2, the engine and the blockout of the whole globe. The build is continuing.
phase 1: 0.13 h used of its 1.00 h box
allowance (before the review): 1.19 h used of 36.00 h allowed

Rough cut, the first shake: winter streaked sideways, crossing into spring
